canonical_route_decision.rule: Security Login Log remains a compatibility surface and device/login sub-capability; it must not be treated as the complete Security Center.

constraints: TOTP and MFA rules are account and funds security controls; they must not re-enable mandatory local PIN setup by default.
Local PIN remains optional by default and only gates explicit local lock/unlock behavior.
Withdrawal, new withdrawal address, TOTP disable, email/phone change, and high-risk remote login are mandatory security scenarios and cannot be disabled by DMP.
Small trades, sensitive profile viewing, trusted-device duration, and device removal can be configured only within the non-mandatory DMP boundary.
All sensitive operations require audit logging with actor, device, IP, riskLevel, result, and requestId.
No page may compute final risk policy locally; risk decision, alert priority, GSL status, and verification method must come from API contract or governed mock schema.
next_stage: Backend validates OpenAPI draft and persistence model.
Risk and compliance confirm TOTP, GSL, remote login, and withdrawal verification thresholds.
Design System confirms registered business components and security patterns before UI build.
App implementation adds /settings/security-center route only after page contract and public-resource QA pass.

blockers_before_code_complete: Production identity/session service is not connected.
TOTP secret storage, recovery-code hashing, and GSL scheduler are backend-owned and not implemented in this package.
DMP policy approval workflow and audit export permissions require security owner review.
Native/compliance review is required for high-risk English and Indonesian security copy.
